title: Hierarchical quant profile selection and per-slice NDCG/MRR validation
text:
Hierarchical quant profile selection and per-slice NDCG/MRR validation

description:
Goal: Build a repeatable process to pick hybrid FP8/INT8 quantization profiles for the reranker that optimizes latency and cost while preserving ranking quality across labeled slices. This ticket scopes the selection algorithm for hierarchical profile candidates, the calibration sampling strategy, the per-slice evaluation harness (NDCG / MRR), and the criteria for rollout/rollback. The outcome should be a documented playbook and automation scripts that produce a ranked list of safe profiles plus a gated CI job that prevents regressions from being promoted.

acceptance_criteria:
1) A reproducible pipeline produces candidate hybrid quant profiles (FP8 where safe, INT8 otherwise) and top-3 ranked candidates for a given model and dataset.
2) Per-slice evaluation reports (NDCG@10 and MRR@10) with bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals for each candidate versus FP32 baseline.
3) No critical slice shows >0.5% absolute NDCG regression or >1.0% relative MRR regression at the chosen profile; otherwise candidate is rejected.
4) CI gate that runs on model change and fails PRs that increase the number of failing slices.
5) Playbook with calibration budget, sampling recipe, and rollback rules checked into docs repo.

plan:
1) Define slice taxonomy and ground-truth datasets (see datasets field).
2) Implement hierarchical profile selector that scores per-layer sensitivity and proposes mixed FP8/INT8 profiles.
3) Build calibration driver: stratified sampler, per-layer calibration schedules, deterministic random seeds.
4) Wire evaluation harness to produce NDCG/MRR + bootstrapped CIs + pairwise significance tests.
5) Run stability sweeps (3 seeds x 5 calibrations) and capture token-level divergences and ranking deltas.
6) Add CI gate + dashboard that surfaces failing slices and latency/cost deltas.

datasets:
- internal-rankset-v2 (50k queries, annotated relevance judgments)
- popularity-balanced-sample (subsample stratified by item popularity)
- long-query-slice (queries > 30 tokens)
- temporal-sensitive-slice (queries with time constraints, e.g., "now", "recent")
- head/tail entity-slice (queries referencing top-100 entities vs long-tail)

metrics:
Primary: NDCG@10 (absolute and delta), MRR@10.
Secondary: P50/P95 latency, tokens/sec, per-request GPU memory, token generation time.
Stat tests: bootstrap 95% CI, paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test for non-normal deltas, Benjamini-Hochberg for multiple slices.
Signal stability: median and MAD across seeds.

calibration_workflow:
- Sampling: stratified by slice and popularity, retain distribution of query lengths (target calibration set size: 1k queries per slice, configurable).
- Per-layer calibration: run dynamic range collection for INT8, scale/fp8-scaling for FP8 layers; keep calibration artifacts versioned.
- Determinism: fixed RNG seeds, deterministic batching order, and pinned minibatch sizes during calibration.
- Budget: default 10k tokens per layer (adjustable via --calib-budget).
- Fallback: if calibration diverges beyond threshold (KL>0.05 vs FP32 logits), mark profile failed and attempt hybrid fallback where only top-k sensitive layers are kept FP32/FP8.

gating_thresholds:
- Critical slices: absolute NDCG@10 drop <= 0.5% from FP32 baseline.
- Non-critical slices: population-weighted NDCG drop <= 1.0%.
- MRR: relative drop <= 1.0% for critical, <=2.5% for non-critical.
- Latency: p95 increase <= 15% or absolute p95 < 120ms (whichever stricter).
- Rollout: require at least 3 successful CI runs on nightly pipeline before canary.
- Emergency rollback: any production slice with >1.0% NDCG loss observed in telemetry triggers immediate rollback.

experiment_matrix:
Axes: quant format (FP8/INT8/fp8-hybrid), calibration budget (2k/10k/50k tokens), seed (3), batch size during calibration (1/8/32), per-layer hybrid heuristics (topk-sensitivity threshold 5%/10%/20%).
Total runs per model: matrix ~ 3 x 3 x 3 x 3 x 3 = ~243 experiments (can be pruned via early stopping based on initial slice failures).

dependencies:
ENG-84412, ENG-87240, PM-412

implementation_tasks:
- impl: sensitivity scorer (ENG)
- impl: calibration-driver CLI + artifacts storage (ENG)
- impl: evaluation harness extension (NDGC bootstrap + p-values) (ENG)
- infra: CI gate + heavy compute job scheduling (infra)
- docs: playbook + rollback checklist (PM/Docs)  

risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: sparse slices with few labels show high variance -> Mitigation: augment with synthetic label generation and lower gating weight; require stability across 3 seeds.
Risk: calibration nondeterminism -> Mitigation: pin RNGs, use deterministic batching and snapshot calibration payloads.
Risk: overfitting calibration to dev set -> Mitigation: hold out 10% unseen queries per slice for validation.


next_steps:
1) Finish sensitivity scorer PR and get code review (assigned to Liam).
2) Wire calibration artifacts to evaluation harness and run first full matrix on a staging GPU cluster.
3) Iterate on gating thresholds after pilot results and update playbook.

notes:
- Prior experiments (see ENG-62107 etc.) showed high sensitivity on attention-projection layers for rare-entity queries; this ticket codifies a hierarchical selection approach so we don't re-run entire brute-force searches.
- We'll reuse the existing regressions harness but extend to compute bootstrapped CIs and auto-generate a per-slice story for PM review.

comments:
2026-02-24 Maya Patel: Ticket created and groomed with ranking team. Agreed scope includes CI gating and dashboarding.

2026-03-02 Engineering sync: Decided to use bootstrap CI approach rather than parametric t-test due to non-normal deltas on tail slices. Added Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
2026-03-05 QA: Ran pilot with 3 candidates; FP8-hybrid candidate A passed all non-critical slices but failed 1 critical slice (NDCG drop = 0.63%). Candidate rejected; logs and calibration artifacts uploaded to drive link.
